subject: Next steps: prompt batch onboarding & evaluation criteria
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@kirbyhealth.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@kirbyhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Next steps: prompt batch onboarding & evaluation criteria

Asha — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we’re aligned before the PoC kicks off:

Summary of call:
- Use case: customer support triage + suggested article generation for Kirby Health portal.
- Scope for trial: 5k prompts representative of recent support queries (title + body + metadata) with a smaller holdout set for blind evaluation.

Success criteria (proposed):
1) Precision@Top1 >= 78% on triage routing labels (measured on holdout).
2) Average token latency (99th) <= 350ms for single-request interactive flows on Redwood Dedicated baseline.
3) Qualitative: CS team rates suggestions as "useful" or "very useful" >= 70% on a 100 sample survey.

Artifacts we need from Kirby (owners and formats):
- Sample prompt batch (3k–5k rows, CSV) — includes: origin_date, user_message, context_tags, expected_label(s), preferred_answer_example (optional). Owner: Asha / Michael.
- Production logs slice (anonymized) — last 30 days, gzipped JSONL. Owner: DevOps/Infra.
- Current label taxonomy and any mapping rules. Owner: Product.

Redwood deliverables & owners:
- Evaluation harness + metrics dashboard (INF-4421) — Sean Gallagher (owner).
- Prompt/label ingestion spec + security checklist — Marissa Cole (owner).
- Weekly sync and canary test plan — Karthik Iyer (owner).

Timeline (proposed):
- 10/8: Kirby uploads initial prompt batch + taxonomy.
- 10/12: Redwood runs initial ingest and shares baseline metrics.
- 10/20: First blind evaluation + qualitative review session with CS.

Request: please upload the prompt CSV and any logs to a shared Drive or S3 link by EOD 10/8. I’ve attached our PoC checklist to make the deliverables explicit.

Attachments:
- [attachment: redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

Thanks — I’ll set up a 30-minute follow-up for 10/13 to review the baseline results and next steps.

— Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Asha Rao <asha.rao@kirbyhealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@kirbyhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 09:03:12 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: prompt batch onboarding & evaluation criteria

Thanks Karthik — this is super helpful and matches our internal notes. Quick answers inline:

> Request: please upload the prompt CSV and any logs to a shared Drive or S3 link by EOD 10/8.

We can meet that. Michael will own the upload. I’ve attached an initial sample file (small extract) so your team can validate the format. Full batch will be available by 10/8.

Attached:
- kirby_prompts_batch_v1.csv (sample, 200 rows)

One note on success criteria: the CS team would prefer a slightly higher qualitative threshold if possible (75%), but we can treat that as a stretch goal and revisit after the first blind eval.

We’re also looping in Michael (DevOps) who will provide the logs slice and coordinate secure transfer via our S3 transfer role.

Thanks — I’ll confirm when the full upload is complete.

Best,
Asha Rao
Senior Product Manager, Kirby Health
asha.rao@kirbyhealth.com
[attachment: kirby_prompts_batch_v1.csv (csv)]

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 11:20:45 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: prompt batch onboarding & evaluation criteria

All — I’ll take INF-4421 and build the baseline eval harness. A few clarifying questions before I start ingest work:

1) Expected label cardinality? Asha mentioned ~12 labels in the taxonomy — can you confirm if that’s fixed or if there are mapping rules (Marissa)?
2) Are we doing prefix/KV caching for the blind eval runs or raw single-request evaluation? My recommendation: run both (raw + cache-enabled) to show cost/perf tradeoffs.
3) Can we get an S3 role or Drive share by EOD 10/8 so I can begin automated pulls?

Planned outputs (for the 10/12 baseline):
- Ingest validation report (schema/row counts/anonymization checks).
- Baseline metrics: accuracy, precision@1, token latency p50/p95/p99, cost estimate for 100k requests.
- Demo notebook with a blind holdout sample.

Marissa — I’ll need the ingestion spec and redaction checklist from you by 10/8 as well so I can wire up the pipeline.

— Sean
Sean Gallagher
Platform Solutions
Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha.rao@kirbyhealth.com>
Cc: Michael Chen <michael.chen@kirbyhealth.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 06 Oct 2026 15:45:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Next steps: prompt batch onboarding & evaluation criteria

Asha — great, thanks for the quick turnaround and for the sample file. Short follow-up items before the upload: 

1) Please confirm the final taxonomy CSV (label_id,label_name,parent_label) is included with the batch.
2) For logs: please ensure PII is redacted and provide a short manifest describing fields and any transformations applied. We can sign an NDA addendum if needed for logs transfer.
3) Upload options: S3 (preferred) — give us a temp role/ARN or a pre-signed URL. Otherwise Drive link is fine (we'll request service account access).

I’ve scheduled the follow-up baseline review for 30 minutes on 10/13 at 10:00am EST — invite to follow. If you can confirm upload timing (target EOD 10/8) we’ll lock in the baseline run for 10/12 as discussed.

Attachments to us (received): kirby_prompts_batch_v1.csv, redwood_poc_checklist.xlsx

Thanks, looking forward to getting started.

— Karthik
